body:
The rest of the description always refers to it as "error", at the cost of clarity. I feel like this can be replicated here too, for consistency. Users experimenting with this class should already know the only difference between the two is an enum value.
```suggestion
				[b]Note:[/b] Logging errors from this method using functions like [method @GlobalScope.push_error] or [method @GlobalScope.push_warning] is not supported, as it could cause infinite recursion. These errors will only show up in the console output.
```
